end.parentNote: Vihaan practised making 100 and counting jumps on a number line. They used the method of moving through tens, such as 80 to 90 to 100, and later answered 30 + 70 correctly. Repeated prompts caused some frustration, but the 30 and 70 partner was corrected later in the lesson. At home, practise a few quick number-line questions using jumps of 10, then ask Vihaan to explain one answer.
